description:
Mode-dependent registration:

- LIVE NETWORK / Remote MCP: does NOT create an account; returns human registration instructions (invitation + Passkey). Connect an existing account with OAuth or an account credential.
- WEBAZ_MODE=sandbox only: creates a LOCAL test account; returned api_key/code/handle exist only on this machine, never on webaz.xyz.

⚠️ **Consent required** before creating a sandbox account for a human. Never auto-register from a generic shopping request.

Roles: buyer | seller | logistics. arbitrator is admin-granted; reviewer has no grant path.

Does NOT set placement_id/sponsor_id. Referral attribution requires the browser share-link flow. region defaults global.

region.description: Account region (default global; affects referral region cap + commission redirect_region_cap rules)

name: webaz_register
